examples.text: tato kukkulavassaṃ samuṭṭhāpesi. accuṇhā kukkulā ākāsen'āgantvā dasabalassa pādamūle candanacuṇṇaṃ hutvā nipatiṃsu. tato vālikavassaṃ samuṭṭhāpesi.
ātaṅkaphassena khudāya phuṭṭho, sītaṃ accuṇhaṃ adhivāsayeyya, so tehi phuṭṭho bahudhā anoko, vīriyaṃ parakkammadaḷhaṃ kareyya.

1002.meaning1: everlasting; eternal; stable; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: ahiṃsakā ye munayo, niccaṃ kāyena saṃvutā, te yanti accutaṃ ṭhānaṃ, yattha gantvā na socare.
jaheyya sabbasaṃyogaṃ, kareyya saraṇ'attano, careyy'ādittasīso'va, patthayaṃ accutaṃ padan'ti.

1005.meaning1: name of two privately awakened Buddhas; Accutagāma and Byāmaka

examples.text: ketumbharāgo ca mātaṅgo ariyo, ath'accuto accutagāmabyāmako, sumaṅgalo dabbilo supatiṭṭhito, asayho khem'ābhirato ca sorato.

accuta + ā

examples.text: varuṇā sahadhammā ca, accutā ca anejakā, sūleyyarucirā āguṃ, āguṃ vāsavanesino, das'ete dasadhā kāyā, sabbe nānattavaṇṇino.

1008.grammar: adj, from acceti, abbrev of accāyika
1008.construction: ati > aty > acc + √i > ay + *a + *ika accaya + *ika > accāyika > acceka
1008.commentary: (VIN 1.4.3.8) accekacīvaraṃ nāma senāya vā gantu'kāmo hoti, pavāsaṃ vā gantu'kāmo hoti, gilāno vā hoti, gabbhinī vā hoti, assaddhassa vā saddhā uppannā hoti, appasannassa vā pasādo uppanno hoti

examples.text: das'āh'ānāgataṃ kattika-temāsika-puṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno pan'eva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ

1009.commentary: (VIN 1.4.3.8) accekacīvaraṃ nāma senāya vā gantu'kāmo hoti, pavāsaṃ vā gantu'kāmo hoti, gilāno vā hoti, gabbhinī vā hoti, assaddhassa vā saddhā uppannā hoti, appasannassa vā pasādo uppanno hoti

examples.text: das'āh'ānāgataṃ kattika-temāsika-puṇṇamaṃ bhikkhuno pan'eva accekacīvaraṃ uppajjeyya, accekaṃ maññamānena bhikkhunā paṭiggahetabbaṃ
so ce bhikkhūnaṃ santike dūtaṃ pahiṇeyya, āgacchantu bhadantā vass'āvāsikaṃ dassāmī'ti, etaṃ accekacīvaraṃ nāma.

1010.commentary: (VINa) accekacīvare accekacīvarasaññī'ti evam'ādi vibhajitvā gahitam'eva sandhāya vuttaṃ. sace pana avibhattaṃ hoti, saṅghassa vā bhaṇḍ'āgāre, cīvarasamay'ātikkame'pi anāpatti. iti atirekacīvarassa das'āhaṃ parihāro. akatassa vassikasāṭikacīvarassa anatthate kathine pañca māsā, vasse ukkaḍḍhite cha māsā, atthate kathine apare cattāro māsā. hemantassa pacchime divase mūlacīvar'ādhiṭṭhānavasena aparo'pi eko māso'ti ekādasa māsā parihāro. satiyā paccāsāya mūlacīvarassa eko māso, accekacīvarassa anatthate kathine ekādasadivas'ādhiko māso, atthate kathine ekādasadivas'ādhikā pañca māsā, tato paraṃ ekadivasam'pi parihāro n'atthī'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: accekacīvare accekacīvarasaññī cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. accekacīvare vematiko cīvarakālasamayaṃ atikkāmeti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

1011.meaning1: rule about an extraordinary robe; Nissaggiya 28

examples.text: accenti kālā tarayanti rattiyo, vayoguṇā anupubbaṃ jahanti, etaṃ bhayaṃ maraṇe pekkhamāno, puññāni kayirātha sukh'āvahānī'ti.
atisītaṃ atiuṇhaṃ, atisāyam'idaṃ ahu, iti vissaṭṭhakamm'ante, khaṇā accenti māṇave.

1018.meaning1: pulled down too low; hanging loose
1018.commentary: (MNa) yo yāva gopphakā otāretvāva pārupati, tassa accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti… yo ek'aṃsaṃ katvā thanaṃ vivaritvā yāti, tassa'pi accukkaṭṭhaṃ.

examples.text: na ca tassa bhoto gotamassa kāye cīvaraṃ accukkaṭṭhaṃ hoti na ca accokkaṭṭhaṃ, na ca kāyasmiṃ allīnaṃ na ca kāyasmā apakaṭṭhaṃ

1020.meaning1: too much water; an excess of water; over-watering

examples.text: atha naṃ sesajanā, amma, tayā katasassaṃ n'eva accodakena, na anudakena nassati, subbuṭṭhidubbuṭṭhibhāvaṃ ñatvā kammaṃ karosi, kiṃ nu kho etan'ti pucchiṃsu.

liṅgaṃ nāma dve liṅgāni, hīnañ'ca liṅgaṃ ukkaṭṭhañ'ca liṅgaṃ. hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ, atidīghaṃ, atirassaṃ, atikaṇhaṃ, accodātaṃ, etaṃ hīnaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ. ukkaṭṭhaṃ nāma liṅgaṃ, nātidīghaṃ, nātirassaṃ, nātikaṇhaṃ, nāccodātaṃ.
seyyathā'pi, brāhmaṇa, udapatto accho vippasanno anāvilo āloke nikkhitto. tattha cakkhumā puriso sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno yathābhūtaṃ jāneyya passeyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, itthī vā puriso vā daharo yuvā maṇḍanakajātiko ādāse vā parisuddhe pariyodāte acche vā udakapatte sakaṃ mukhanimittaṃ paccavekkhamāno
sārambhaṃ nāma… dīpīnaṃ vā āsayo hoti, acchānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, taracchānaṃ vā āsayo hoti, yesaṃ kesañci tiracchānagatānaṃ pāṇānaṃ āsayo hoti, pubb'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti, apar'aṇṇanissitaṃ vā hoti
catuppadānan'ti sīhā byagghā dīpi acchā taracchā kokā mahiṃsā hatthī.
tasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye pesalā bhikkhū tuṇhībhūtā tuṇhībhūtā'va saṅghamajjhe saṅkasāyanti paccantime vā janapade acchanti.
tena kho pana samayena jānapadā manussā bahuṃ loṇam'pi telam'pi taṇḍulam'pi khādanīyam'pi sakaṭesu āropetvā bahārāmakoṭṭhake sakaṭaparivaṭṭaṃ karitvā acchanti

1026.synonym: ajjhāvasati, āvasati, tiṭṭhati, paṭivasati, vasati, viharati
1026.commentary: (VINa) imāya'p'ime āyasmanto ratiyā'ti imāya saggamaggassa tiracchānabhūtāya tiracchānakathāratiyā. acchissantī'ti viharissanti.

examples.text: ye te bhikkhū tiracchānakathikā kāyadaḷhibahulā viharanti tesam'pi ekajjhaṃ sen'āsanaṃ paññapeti, imāya'p'ime āyasmanto ratiyā acchissantī'ti.

1027.construction:
na > a + √chand + a + ika
achanda + ika

examples.text: anāpatti dvetisso rattiyo vasati, ūnakadvetisso rattiyo vasati, dve rattiyo vasitvā tatiyāya rattiyā pur'āruṇā nikkhamitvā puna vasati, sabbacchanne, sabbaaparicchanne, sabbaparicchanne sabbaacchanne, yebhuyyena acchanne, yebhuyyena aparicchanne

1029.meaning1: not terrified; not paralysed with fear
1029.commentary: (THa) satthā maṃ pucchatī'ti uppajjanakassa chambhitattassa bhayassa ca setughātena pahīnattā acchambhī ca abhīto ca byākāsi.

examples.text: atha āgaccheyya suddakumāro susikkhito katahattho katayoggo kat'ūpāsano abhīru acchambhī anutrāsī apalāyī. bhareyyāsi taṃ purisaṃ, attho ca te tādisena purisenā'ti?
tato pañhe apucchi maṃ, pañhānaṃ kovido vidū, acchambhī ca abhīto ca, byākāsiṃ satthuno ahaṃ.
balavā puriso appakasiren'eva accharaṃ pahareyya
balavā puriso appakasiren'eva accharaṃ pahareyya

1033.commentary: (SNa) accharāsaṅghaparivutā'ti accharā'ti devadhītānaṃ nāmaṃ, tāsaṃ samūhena parivutā.
1033.notes: MW: from ap + √sṛ, going in the waters or between the waters of the clouds.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi
accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ, pisācagaṇasevitaṃ, van'antaṃ mohanaṃ nāma, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

1034.meaning1: short moment; split second; tiny amount of time

examples.text: paṇṇavīsativassāni, yato pabbajitā ahaṃ, na-accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi, cittass'ūpasam'ajjhagaṃ.

1035.meaning1: group of celestial nymphs; crowd of female nature divinities

examples.text: accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ, pisācagaṇasevitaṃ, van'antaṃ mohanaṃ nāma, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

1036.meaning1: serenaded by a group of celestial nymphs; sung to by a crowd of female nature divinities

examples.text: accharāgaṇasaṅghuṭṭhaṃ, pisācagaṇasevitaṃ, van'antaṃ mohanaṃ nāma, kathaṃ yātrā bhavissatī'ti.

1037.meaning1: surrounded by a retinue of celestial nymphs; accompanied by an entourage of female divinities
1037.commentary: (SNa) accharāsaṅghaparivutā'ti accharā'ti devadhītānaṃ nāmaṃ, tāsaṃ samūhena parivutā.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, aññatarā tāvatiṃsakāyikā devatā nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivutā dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitā samaṅgībhūtā paricāriyamānā tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imaṃ gāthaṃ abhāsi

so tattha nandane vane accharāsaṅghaparivuto dibbehi pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappito samaṅgībhūto paricāreyya. so passeyya gahapatiṃ vā gahapatiputtaṃ vā pañcahi kāmaguṇehi samappitaṃ samaṅgībhūtaṃ paricārayamānaṃ.

1038.commentary: (ANa) accharāsaṅghātamattan'ti accharāpaharaṇamattaṃ, dve aṅguliyo paharitvā saddakaraṇamattan'ti attho.

examples.text: accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettācittaṃ āsevati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arittajjhāno viharati satthusāsanakaro ovādapatikaro, amoghaṃ raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati. ko pana vādo ye naṃ bahulīkarontī'ti!

1039.meaning1: for the time it takes to click the fingers; for a finger snap
1039.commentary: (ANa) idāni'ssa upamaṃ dassento āha, antamaso accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pī'ti. sabb'antimena paricchedena dve aṅguliyo ekato katvā paharaṇamattam'pi kālan'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: accharāsaṅghāta-mattam'pi ce, bhikkhave, bhikkhu mettācittaṃ āsevati, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, bhikkhu arittajjhāno viharati satthusāsanakaro ovādapatikaro, amoghaṃ raṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ bhuñjati. ko pana vādo ye naṃ bahulīkarontī'ti!
seyyathā'pi, ānanda, balavā puriso appakasiren'eva accharikaṃ pahareyya

so theraṃ nisīdāpetvā bahi nikkhanto. thero tassa saha nikkhamanā'va arahattaṃ patvā accharikāya saññaṃ adāsi. saṅgho sannipatitvā āha, bhante, evarūpe maraṇakāle lok'uttaradhammaṃ nibbattentā dukkaraṃ karitthā'ti.
sattahi, bhikkhave, acchariyehi abbhutehi dhammehi samannāgataṃ hatthakaṃ āḷavakaṃ dhāretha.
acchariyā h'ete, āvuso, puggalā dullabhā lokasmiṃ, ye amataṃ dhātuṃ kāyena phusitvā viharanti

yañ'ca kho, omāti, bhante, bhagavā iddhiyā manomayena kāyena brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamituṃ, yañ'ca kho abhijānāti, bhante, bhagavā iminā cātumahābhūtikena kāyena iddhiyā brahmalokaṃ upasaṅkamitā, ta'y'idaṃ, bhante, bhagavato acchariyañ'c'eva abbhutañ'cā'ti.

1047.meaning1: connected with marvellous and wonderful phenomena

1049.meaning1: leading to the wonderful; going to the marvellous

examples.text: acchariyañ'ca vo, bhikkhave, desessāmi acchariyagāmiñ'ca maggaṃ. taṃ suṇātha.

1050.commentary: (MNt) abhirūpatā dīgh'āyukatā, appātaṅkatā brāhmaṇ'ādīnaṃ piyamanāpatā'ti catūhi acchariyadhammehi.

1052.meaning1: having wonderful qualities; with marvellous characteristics

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bhante, āyasmā ānando amhe etadavoca, acchariyā c'eva, āvuso, tathāgatā acchariyadhammasamannāgatā ca, abbhutā c'eva, āvuso, tathāgatā abbhutadhammasamannāgatā cā'ti. ayaṃ kho no, bhante, antarākathā vippakatā, atha bhagavā anuppatto'ti.

1053.meaning1: struck with wonder and amazement; with hearts full of astonishment and surprise
1053.commentary: (MNa) acchariy'abbhutacittajātā'ti aho acchariyaṃ, aho abbhutan'ti evaṃ sañjāt'ācchariy'ābbhutā c'eva sañjātatuṭṭhino ca ahesuṃ uppannabalavasomanassā.

examples.text: atha kho sā parisā acchariy'abbhutacittajātā ahosi, acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho, yatra hi nām'āyaṃ brahm'āyu brāhmaṇo ñāto yasassī evarūpaṃ paramanipaccakāraṃ karissatī'ti.
atha kho, bhikkhave, brahmā ca brahmaparisā ca brahmapārisajjā ca acchariy'abbhutacittajātā ahesuṃ, acchariyaṃ vata bho, abbhutaṃ vata bho!

1054.commentary: (ANa) acchariyamanusso'ti acchariyo manusso. acchariyo'ti andhassa pabbat'ārohaṇaṃ viya niccaṃ na hotī'ti attho. ayaṃ tāva saddanayo. ayaṃ pana aṭṭhakathānayo, accharāyoggo'ti acchariyo, accharaṃ paharitvā passitabbo'ti attho. apica tathāgatassa, bhikkhave, arahato sammāsambuddhassa pātubhāvā cattāro acchariyā abbhutā dhammā pātubhavantī'ti (a. ni. 4.127) evam'ādīhi anekehi acchariyabbhutadhammehi samannāgatattāpi acchariyamanusso. āciṇṇamanusso'ti'pi acchariyamanusso. (ANa) acchariyamanussā'ti āciṇṇamanussā abbhutamanussā.

examples.text: tathāgato ca arahaṃ sammāsambuddho, rājā ca cakkavattī. ime kho, bhikkhave, dve puggalā loke uppajjamānā uppajjanti acchariyamanussā'ti.

1055.grammar: ind, excl, acc sg of acchariya

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, bhante, abbhutaṃ, bhante!
acchariyaṃ, moggallāna, abbhutaṃ, moggallāna! yāva bāhāgahaṇā'pi nāma so moghapuriso āgamessatī'ti
bhuñjati anavajjāni, sāvajjāni na bhuñjati, ghāsam'acchādanaṃ laddhā, sannidhiṃ parivajjayaṃ.
sa kho so, bhikkhave, bālo abyatto akusalo sūdo na c'eva lābhī hoti acchādanassa, na lābhī vetanassa, na lābhī abhihārānaṃ. taṃ kissa hetu?

1059.meaning1: clothing, cloth, and the finest cloak
1059.compound: dvanda (acchādana ca vattha ca mokkhapāvuraṇa ca)

examples.text: lābhī acchādana-vattha-mokkhapāvuraṇānaṃ, bhavati yadi anāgāriyataṃ upeti, sahito purimakataphalaṃ anubhavati, na bhavati katassa panāso'ti.

1062.grammar: abs of caus of ā √chad, caus, trans (+acc)
1062.meaning1: having made put on; having clothed (in)
1062.meaning2: having caused to put on; having clothed

examples.text: paṭhamaṃ kesamassuṃ ohārāpetvā, kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādāpetvā, ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ kārāpetvā, bhikkhūnaṃ pāde vandāpetvā, ukkuṭikaṃ nisīdāpetvā, añjaliṃ paggaṇhāpetvā, evaṃ vadehī'ti vattabbo
siṅgīvaṇṇaṃ yugamaṭṭhaṃ, pukkuso abhihārayi, tena acchādito satthā, hemavaṇṇo asobhathā'ti.

1064.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.8) acchādessāmī'ti dassāmi. (DNa) acchādehī'ti upacāravacanam'etaṃ, ekaṃ mayhaṃ dehi, ekaṃ ānandassā'ti attho.

examples.text: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissa aññātakassa gahapatissa vā gahapatāniyā vā cīvaracetāpannaṃ upakkhaṭaṃ hoti, iminā cīvaracetāpannena cīvaraṃ cetāpetvā itthan'nāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ cīvarena acchādessāmī'ti
tena hi, pukkusa, ekena maṃ acchādehi, ekena ānandan'ti. evaṃ, bhante'ti kho pukkuso mallaputto bhagavato paṭissutvā ekena bhagavantaṃ acchādeti, ekena āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ.

1066.meaning1: wanting to clothe; wanting to buy cloth (for)

examples.text: bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissā'ti bhikkhuss'atthāya, bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā, bhikkhuṃ acchādetu'kāmo.
bhikkhuṃ pan'eva uddissā'ti bhikkhuss'atthāya, bhikkhuṃ ārammaṇaṃ karitvā, bhikkhuṃ acchādetu'kāmo.

1068.meaning1: having dressed; having clothed oneself (in); having put on

examples.text: atha kho bho mahāgovindo brāhmaṇo tassa satt'āhassa accayena kesamassuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbaji
sace vo, dhanena attho, khippaṃ maṃ bandhanā mocetvā sīsaṃ nhāpetvā ahatavatthāni acchādetvā gandhehi vilimpāpetvā pupphāni pilandhāpetvā ṭhapethā'ti.
atha kho dasamo gahapati aṭṭhakanāgaro… ekam'ekañ'ca bhikkhuṃ paccekaṃ dussayugena acchādesi, āyasmantañ'ca ānandaṃ ticīvarena acchādesi, āyasmato ca ānandassa pañcasatavihāraṃ kārāpesī'ti.
atha kho te pañca rājāno candanaṅgalikaṃ upāsakaṃ pañcahi uttarāsaṅgehi acchādesuṃ. atha kho candanaṅgaliko upāsako tehi pañcahi uttarāsaṅgehi bhagavantaṃ acchādesī'ti.
tesaṃ rasapathaviṃ aṅguliyā sāyataṃ acchādesi, taṇhā ca tesaṃ okkami.
sare hatthehi bhañjitvā, katvāna kuṭim'acchisaṃ, tena me sarabhaṅgo'ti, nāmaṃ sammutiyā ahu.
tena kho pana samayena, rañño ambo dhuvaphalo hoti. atha kho, bhikkhave, so chapako yena so ambo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ ambaṃ abhiruhitvā nilīno acchi.

addasā kho bhagavā magadhakhettaṃ acchibaddhaṃ pāḷibaddhaṃ mariyādabaddhaṃ siṅghāṭakabaddhaṃ, disvāna āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ āmantesi, passasi no tvaṃ, ānanda, magadhakhettaṃ acchibaddhaṃ pāḷibaddhaṃ mariyādabaddhaṃ siṅghāṭakabaddhan'ti? evaṃ, bhante'ti.

1074.meaning2: robbed, plundered, took by force, broke off

1075.meaning2: to be seated; to remain seated

examples.text: kusalī bhāsasī tesaṃ, mārapāsappahāyinaṃ, kassa te dhammam'aññāya, acchiduṃ bhavabandhanan'ti.
seyyathā'pi, bhante, selo pabbato acchiddo asusiro ekagghano. atha puratthimāya ce'pi disāya āgaccheyya bhusā vātavuṭṭhi n'eva naṃ saṅkampeyya na sampakampeyya na sampavedheyya
yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.

1078.meaning1: whose behaviour is not broken; whose conduct is not flawed; not defective in character

examples.text: idha pana, bhikkhave, puggalo puggalena saddhiṃ saṃvasamāno evaṃ jānāti, dīgharattaṃ kho ayam'āyasmā akhaṇḍakārī acchiddakārī asabalakārī akammāsakārī santatakārī santatavutti, sīlesu sīlavā ayam'āyasmā, n'āyam'āyasmā dussīlo'ti.

1079.meaning1: with flawless behaviour; with unbroken lifestyle

examples.text: yaṃ ce viññū pasaṃsanti, anuvicca suve suve, acchiddavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, paññāsīlasamāhitaṃ.

1080.meaning1: takes back; snatches back; tears away

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
acchindeyyā'ti sayaṃ acchindati, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

1083.commentary: (CPa) acchindanto puraṃ mamā'ti mama bārāṇasinagaraṃ balakkārena gaṇhanto.

examples.text: evaṃ me appamattassa, idha loke parattha ca, dabbaseno upagantvā, acchindanto puraṃ mama.
mamāyite passatha phandamāne'ti mamāyitaṃ vatthuṃ acchedasaṃkino'pi phandanti, acchindante'pi phandanti, acchinne'pi phandanti

1084.meaning1: causes to take; makes snatch; causes to tear away

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhussa sāmaṃ cīvaraṃ datvā kupito anattamano acchindeyya vā acchindāpeyya vā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

1085.meaning1: caused to take; made snatch; caused to tear away

examples.text: niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.

1089.meaning1: having snatched away; having stolen; having robbed (something from)

examples.text: taṃ maṃ tato satthavāho, ussannāya vipulāya vaḍḍhiyā, okaḍḍhati vilapantiṃ, acchinditvā kulagharasmā.
anāpatti antodas'āhaṃ adhiṭṭheti, vikappeti, vissajjeti, nassati, vinassati, ḍayhati, acchinditvā gaṇhanti, vissāsaṃ gaṇhanti, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

1091.meaning2: robbed, plundered, took by force, broke off
1091.commentary: (VIN 1.4.6) acchinnacīvaro nāma bhikkhussa cīvaraṃ acchinnaṃ hoti rājūhi vā corehi vā dhuttehi vā, yehi kehici vā acchinnaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
acchinnacīvaro nāma bhikkhussa cīvaraṃ acchinnaṃ hoti rājūhi vā corehi vā dhuttehi vā, yehi kehici vā acchinnaṃ hoti.

1092.commentary: (KVt) acchinnamūlo bhavissatī'ti pārājikaṃ anāpanno bhavissati, sīlavā bhavissatī'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yadā pana pārājikena vā pārājikasāmantena vā codiyamānassa aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarato pāp'ussannatāya pāpiyassa puggalassa sac'āyaṃ acchinnamūlo bhavissati, sammā vattitvā osāraṇaṃ labhissati.

1093.meaning2: new, not yet cut up (of cloth)

examples.text: anāpatti, sesakaṃ āharissāmī'ti haranto gacchati, sesakaṃ tuyh'eva hotū'ti denti, na acchinnakāraṇā denti, na naṭṭhakāraṇā denti, ñātakānaṃ, pavāritānaṃ, attano dhanena, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

1096.meaning1: whose robe has been stolen; whose robe is taken
1096.commentary: (VIN 1.4.1.6) acchinnacīvaro nāma bhikkhussa cīvaraṃ acchinnaṃ hoti rājūhi vā corehi vā dhuttehi vā, yehi kehici vā acchinnaṃ hoti.

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu aññātakaṃ gahapatiṃ vā gahapatāniṃ vā cīvaraṃ viññāpeyya aññatra samayā, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. tatth'āyaṃ samayo, acchinnacīvaro vā hoti bhikkhu, naṭṭhacīvaro vā, ayaṃ tattha samayo.
tañ'ce'ti acchinnacīvarakaṃ bhikkhuṃ.

1098.meaning1: not cut off at the root; not severed at the source

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, ye te bhikkhū bahussutā āgat'āgamā dhammadharā vinayadharā mātikādharā, te sakkaccaṃ sutt'antaṃ paraṃ vācenti. tesaṃ accayena acchinnamūlako sutt'anto hoti sappaṭisaraṇo. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, tatiyo dhammo saddhammassa ṭhitiyā asammosāya anantaradhānāya saṃvattati.

1099.meaning1: with the head not cut off; not decapitated

examples.text: yassa so bhinno, ayaṃ chinnasīso viya puriso hatthapāde sesāni rakkhissatīt'i na vattabbo. yassa pana so arogo, ayaṃ acchinnasīso viya puriso jīvitaṃ sesāni puna pākatikāni katvā rakkhituṃ sakkoti.
